lede: The biggest thing on the board this week is Mountain Village Town Council's vote Wednesday on a sale price appreciation cap for deed-restricted units — the kind of policy detail that determines whether affordable housing actually stays affordable or quietly drifts out of reach. Also worth your time: Telluride's P&Z takes up the school district's employee housing proposal Thursday, HARC reviews the long-running Shandoka redevelopment at 860 Black Bear Rd on Tuesday, and the BOCC holds a public hearing Wednesday tied to affordable housing compliance. School starts Tuesday for Telluride R-1 kids, so expect the box canyon to feel a little different by midweek.
